title: AgentsWorktree
description: The subagents of a worktree after a layout and what the layout changed there.

task.description: The task the worktree holds, such as SHOP-3; absent for a free worktree, whose subagents are those of the active flow.

missing.description: Present and true if the directory of the worktree does not exist: the worktree is skipped.

agents.description: Identifiers of the subagents laid out in the worktree.

added.description: Subagents whose files the layout wrote anew.

updated.description: Subagents whose files the layout rewrote.

removed.description: Subagents no more in the flow whose files the layout removed.
